service, and uncaring too.
They neglect you for years, then when you finally get an appointment you're rushed, don't get to say all you need to, and leave not being much wiser as to what's up.
Then you can only have a phone appointment after that, in at least 3 week's time, which they then cancel on the day without telling you.
You call them as it's getting late in the day for this phone call, and you're told that you're still on the list for a phone call, but you never get that call.
They keep doing this!
They confuse you, mix up your medication and doseage, and never follow up with anything they need to.
You're endlessly on the phone to them to get everything sorted.
